description: This file defines data structures and a class for managing instances, presence, and related state in a macOS application. It includes model definitions like InstanceInfo and the observable singleton class InstancesStore, which handles fetching, updating, and notifying about instances and presence events.

classes.name: InstancesStore
classes.description: An observable singleton class that manages instance and presence data, handles fetching updates, processing push events, and notifying about node connections.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins periodic updates and push handling for the instances store.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops periodic updates and push handling.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the current presence data from the control channel, updates internal state, and triggers health probes if necessary.

methods.name: localFallbackInstance
methods.description: Creates a fallback InstanceInfo representing the local machine when actual presence data is unavailable.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events related to presence and triggers refresh or payload processing.

methods.name: decodeAndApplyPresenceData
methods.description: Decodes presence data and applies it to update the internal state.

methods.name: handlePresenceEventPayload
methods.description: Decodes and applies presence event payloads.

methods.name: normalizePresence
methods.description: Converts presence entries into InstanceInfo objects with unique IDs.

methods.name: applyPresence
methods.description: Updates the store's instances list with the new presence data and notifies about node connections.

methods.name: notifyOnNodeLogin
methods.description: Sends notifications for newly connected nodes.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Creates a preview InstancesStore with sample instances for UI previews.
